focus: For this initial-rate model, v = Vmax*S/(Km+S). The substrate concentration S and Km use the same concentration unit.
excerpt:
The Kinetics of Invertase Action (1913), Johnson and Goody translation. Equations (3)-(4), PDF page 11.
where C is the proportionality constant.
Equation transcription: Equation (3) transcribed: nu = C*Phi*[S]/([S]+k). Modern teaching notation: v = Vmax*S/(Km+S).
